lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the gill region, with spot size and inter-cluster spacing increasing toward the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a coarse rectangular grid of anchor nodes visible in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features across the upper lateral flank, defined by a sharp pixel intensity transition from high-luminance dorsal edges to low-luminance shadowed ventral edges.
